text:
maya (eng-release): Hey team — planning a non-disruptive rollout of v2.4.1 to production tomorrow 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC. Alex will run the deploy. Quick asks: 1) confirm rollback plan; 2) support smoke checks; 3) marketing/CS release blurb. Ping relevant people. :rocket:

alex (infra): I'm the deploy owner. Will be on standby from 17:30 UTC. No downtime expected. I'll cut a canary to 10% then ramp. Rollback is automated via `rctl rollback --release v2.4.0`. Will post runbook link.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window for v2.4.1 at 2026-04-02T18:00:00Z. Reminder 30m before.

maya (eng-release): Thanks — @jamie @lina @sam can you confirm you can do smoke tests / comms?

jamie (support): I can cover smoke checks. What's the checklist? paste: smoke steps include login, create-inference, run-embedding on sample, check latency < 450ms. I'll run from EU and US. Add runbook link pls.

alex (infra): Smoke checklist (quick):
```
# smoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"hello"}'
# embedding
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq '.data'
# latency check
tail -n 100 /var/log/infer/runtime.log | grep 'latency'
```
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-v2.4.1

taylor (sre): I'll monitor SLOs during rollout. If error rate spike > 0.8% for 5m, we'll pause. I can trigger rollback if needed.

lina (marketing): Need 2-line blurb and 1 screenshot. Suggested blurb: "v2.4.1: improved inference latency and embeddings reliability." I'll prep assets; drop them here by EOD.

sam (product): This release flips on feature_flag "batching_v2" for 100% after canary. Please don't flip until QA thumbs up. We'll coordinate via this thread.

maya (eng-release): Great. @alex confirm rollback tested? Also @jamie confirm you'd like a canned support message?

alex (infra): Rollback CMD tested on staging. I'll keep standby scripts ready. Command: `rctl promote --release v2.4.0` to rollback full. I'll post a short playbook before deploy.

jamie (support): Yes please drop a canned reply for customers — "We're performing a production upgrade, no impact expected, contact support if you see errors." I'll also run the smoke tests and paste results here.

maya (eng-release): Perfect. Final checklist: deploy owner = alex, SRE = taylor, Support = jamie, Marketing = lina, Product = sam. Deploy 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC. If no blockers, I'll hit the schedule button at 17:30 UTC.

alex (infra): ACK. I'll post live status updates during the window.
